reuse.why: The local unlink copies the field-clearing update from unlinkAccount instead of extracting that step into a shared local-unlink helper that both unlinkAccount and the link path call.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount block (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, status set to null) is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: Threading the flag through every provider link function into the shared pre-link check keeps one entry point, but a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked now mutates other accounts, which hides a side effect inside an assertion.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing through the six link functions and the check are touched.

maintainability.why: Single shared hook point is good, but the copied unlink state and a mutating 'assert' make future changes to what 'unlinked' means easy to miss here.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts re-does unlinkAccount's account-clearing update inline rather than going through a shared (local-only) unlink helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied update block in assertBankAccountNotLinked is a plain verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not disguised.
